summary: Dependency-free SVG radar (spider) chart: compares one or more series across three or more dimensions arranged around a center, with keyboard navigation between axes and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Multidimensional profiles: skills, evaluation scores, product characteristics.
Comparing a few series (2–4) on the same dimensions, all expressed on the same scale.
Highlighting strengths and gaps at a glance.
whenNotToUse: Dimensions with different units or scales: normalize the data or use multiple BarCharts.
Precise values to compare or many overlapping series: use BarChart or a table.
Fewer than three dimensions: the polygon is meaningless, use BarChart.

props.name: axes
props.description: Dimensions arranged clockwise starting at 12 o'clock (at least 3).

props.name: series
props.description: Series; data[i] maps to axes[i]. null skips the axis (the polygon connects the available axes).

props.name: max
props.description: Value of the outer ring; defaults to the “rounded” maximum of the visible data. Values are clamped to 0…max.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: description
props.description: Visible description below the title (scale, period, source).

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum radar diameter in px; the chart shrinks with its container.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of values and ring labels (percent, unit, decimals…) in the current locale.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend; with multiple series each entry is a button that shows/hides the series.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called when the legend changes the visible series.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses gradient areas, glows and soft rings with the same theme colors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area (then to the legend and the table button).
Next axis clockwise (wraps from last to first): shows and announces the values of all visible series.

accessibility: <figure> + <figcaption> structure; the chart area is a focusable role="group", named by the title and described by a hint on using the arrow keys.
Keyboard movement updates an aria-live="polite" region with the axis and formatted values; the active axis is highlighted (spoke and label).
The SVG is decorative (aria-hidden): the full data is in the table (rows = axes, columns = series) opened by the "Mostra tabella dati" button.
Series don't rely on color alone: outline dash pattern and marker shape vary per series; the legend uses aria-pressed.
In forced-colors mode outlines and areas use CanvasText, the active axis Highlight.
responsive: The SVG uses a viewBox: it scales down proportionally with its container up to size px in diameter, leaving room for the axis labels.
Entrance animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints areas with gradients between --dc-color-data-N and --dc-color-accent-default, rings filled with --dc-color-surface-subtle and the active spoke in --dc-color-action-primary.
commonMistakes: Mixing dimensions with different scales (e.g. euros and percentages) on the same radar.
Passing fewer than three axes or data with a different length than axes.
Leaving max automatic when the scale is known (e.g. 100 or 5): set max for consistent comparisons across charts.
Overlaying too many series: beyond 3–4 the polygons become unreadable.

examples.name: WithMissingValues
examples.title: Missing values
examples.description: null skips the axis; the polygon connects the available values.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradient areas and glows with the theme colors.

limits: A single linear radial scale from 0 to max for all axes; negative values are treated as 0.
Label width is estimated (no text measurement): very long labels reduce the radar's space.
Axes are arranged clockwise even in RTL.
